body.name: conventional role-selected proximal ATT
body.construction: For each role, compute \(\widehat M_s\), \(\widehat\mu_s^{\mathrm{post}}\), \(\widehat H_s\), the fitted scores \(\widehat\psi_{s,t}\) and \(\widehat v_{s,t}\), their centered sample autocovariances through \(q_n=\lfloor\min(n,m)^{1/5}\rfloor\), and the Bartlett estimates \(\widehat\Omega_{\psi,s}\) and \(\widehat\Omega_{v,s}\). Set \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{sel}}=\widehat\tau_{\widehat J}\), \(\widehat{\operatorname{se}}^{\mathrm{conv}}_s=\{\widehat\Omega_{\psi,s}/n+\widehat\Omega_{v,s}/m\}^{1/2}\), and report \([\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{sel}}\pm z\widehat{\operatorname{se}}^{\mathrm{conv}}_{\widehat J}]\). This construction uses the full pre-period sample both to select the role and to fit its bridge, unlike \(\text{def:gap-split-estimator}\).
